purpose: Original documentary exterior over one retained Canadian building record at Fernwood, PEI. This is a game artwork and an approximate site/appearance registration, not a new survey, port approach chart or grade correction.

sources.authority: Parks Canada, Directory of Federal Heritage Designations: Seacow Head Lighthouse
sources.role: 198 Lighthouse Road, Fernwood; tapered white octagonal tower, 18.3m height, flared cornice, red gallery/lantern and pedimented openings. Heritage architectural identity, not traced geometry.

sources.authority: Canadian Coast Guard notice to mariners: Atlantic Coast, Prince Edward Island, light 1018/H1046
sources.role: Active aid at outer end of point: 18.3m structure versus 26.8m light reference above water. Chart-list locator is not the precise game footing. No operational flashes, nominal visibility or navigation promise in this study.

Nominal base side 11ft3in (3.429m), distinct circular lower lantern, twelve principal lantern panels/cap segments, vents. Original artistic, nontraced execution. Exact current opening dimensions/bearings not measured.

sources.authority: Environment and Climate Change Canada, 2021–22 Federal Contaminated Sites Action Plan annual report: Seacow Head Lightstation case study
sources.role: Completed white shaker-style vinyl replacement, metal window flashings and repainted cupola. Original optical course shading is deliberately quiet; no 2015 peeling wood or restored-site photo texture.

sources.authority: Natural Resources Canada: Automatically Extracted Buildings (AEB), existing PEI 2020 source
sources.role: Existing game packaged 272-row tile; #133 independently recognized as tower role using civic/second footprint. Only its original 22 triangles are omitted. No raw survey-Z fit.

sources.authority: PEI provincial civic address and newer building footprint map
sources.role: Independent QA-only identity/topology check. Civic point is inside both differently sized candidate footprints, centers about 2.35m apart. No new administrative geometry, map imagery or parcel data is distributed.

sources.authority: Dennis G. Jarvis, 11 October 2015, one photographic session
sources.sourceLicense: CC BY-SA 2.0 on indicated photograph pages
sources.role: Viewed for broad form, sash hierarchy and material relationships. No original/altered pixels, image projections, image textures, logos, signs or fitted camera dimensions in runtime or gallery.

evidenceBounds.modelYaw: Approximate: preserves an old octagonal axis and landward opening relationship; not a surveyed exterior or faithful reproduction of every side.
evidenceBounds.safety: No changes to terrain, coastline, collider, vegetation, road, protected adjacent property or published job of CCG aid.

artistOutput.physicalWorldFooting: Eight actual level-plan sides, each with eight slope-following lower segments; no terrain edits. The grade and triangle intersections are relative to this simulator only.
artistOutput.runtimeAssetPolicy: No new photographed texture, original GIS or native LiDAR payload. One locally bundled art module and original packed AEB read.
